objective: Definir el contrato puro de aplicacion transaccional de beneficios Cavas. El dominio debe recibir una elegibilidad ya resuelta como APLICA, una politica/version identificable y una base monetaria elegible, calcular el ajuste autorizado y producir una instruccion auditable para el adaptador transaccional. Cavas NO debe escribir directamente ventas, tickets, cargos ni inventario del POS/ERP. Debe soportar descuento porcentual, descuento de monto fijo y precio final fijo, limitar cualquier ajuste al monto elegible y conservar evidencia completa de politica, contrato, unidad, transaccion origen, linea beneficiada, moneda, monto original, monto final y delta.

class BenefitAdjustmentKind(str, Enum):
    PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT = "PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT"
    FIXED_DISCOUNT = "FIXED_DISCOUNT"
    FIXED_FINAL_PRICE = "FIXED_FINAL_PRICE"


class BenefitApplicationStatus(str, Enum):
    CALCULATED = "CALCULATED"
    SENT_TO_PROVIDER = "SENT_TO_PROVIDER"
    CONFIRMED = "CONFIRMED"
    REJECTED = "REJECTED"
    FAILED = "FAILED"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BenefitApplicationRequest:
    application_id: str
    policy_id: str
    policy_version: str
    contract_id: str
    unit_id: str
    source_system: str
    source_transaction_id: str
    requested_line: str
    currency: str
    eligibility_decision: str
    eligible_base_amount: float
    adjustment_kind: BenefitAdjustmentKind
    adjustment_value: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BenefitApplicationCalculation:
    application_id: str
    original_amount: float
    adjustment_amount: float
    final_amount: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BenefitApplicationInstruction:
    application_id: str
    policy_id: str
    policy_version: str
    contract_id: str
    unit_id: str
    source_system: str
    source_transaction_id: str
    requested_line: str
    currency: str
    original_amount: float
    final_amount: float
    adjustment_amount: float
    status: BenefitApplicationStatus = BenefitApplicationStatus.CALCULATED
    provider_reference: Optional[str] = None
    evidence_reference: Optional[str] = None


def validate_benefit_application_request(request: BenefitApplicationRequest) -> None:
    required = {
        "application_id": request.application_id,
        "policy_id": request.policy_id,
        "policy_version": request.policy_version,
        "contract_id": request.contract_id,
        "unit_id": request.unit_id,
        "source_system": request.source_system,
        "source_transaction_id": request.source_transaction_id,
        "requested_line": request.requested_line,
        "currency": request.currency,
    }
    for field_name, value in required.items():
        if not str(value or "").strip():
            raise ValueError(f"BenefitApplicationRequest requiere {field_name}")
    if str(request.eligibility_decision or "").strip().upper() != "APLICA":
        raise ValueError("No se puede calcular/aplicar un beneficio sin elegibilidad APLICA")
    if request.eligible_base_amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("eligible_base_amount no puede ser negativo")
    if request.adjustment_value < 0:
        raise ValueError("adjustment_value no puede ser negativo")
    if request.adjustment_kind == BenefitAdjustmentKind.PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT and request.adjustment_value > 100:
        raise ValueError("El descuento porcentual no puede exceder 100")
    if request.adjustment_kind == BenefitAdjustmentKind.FIXED_FINAL_PRICE and request.adjustment_value > request.eligible_base_amount:
        raise ValueError("El precio final fijo no puede exceder la base elegible en este contrato de beneficio")


def calculate_benefit_application(request: BenefitApplicationRequest) -> BenefitApplicationCalculation:
    validate_benefit_application_request(request)
    base = round(float(request.eligible_base_amount), 2)
    if request.adjustment_kind == BenefitAdjustmentKind.PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT:
        adjustment = round(base * (float(request.adjustment_value) / 100.0), 2)
    elif request.adjustment_kind == BenefitAdjustmentKind.FIXED_DISCOUNT:
        adjustment = min(base, round(float(request.adjustment_value), 2))
    elif request.adjustment_kind == BenefitAdjustmentKind.FIXED_FINAL_PRICE:
        adjustment = round(base - float(request.adjustment_value), 2)
    else:
        raise ValueError("Tipo de ajuste de beneficio no soportado")
    adjustment = min(base, max(0.0, adjustment))
    final_amount = round(base - adjustment, 2)
    return BenefitApplicationCalculation(
        application_id=request.application_id,
        original_amount=base,
        adjustment_amount=adjustment,
        final_amount=final_amount,
    )


def build_benefit_application_instruction(request: BenefitApplicationRequest) -> BenefitApplicationInstruction:
    calculation = calculate_benefit_application(request)
    return BenefitApplicationInstruction(
        application_id=request.application_id,
        policy_id=request.policy_id,
        policy_version=request.policy_version,
        contract_id=request.contract_id,
        unit_id=request.unit_id,
        source_system=request.source_system,
        source_transaction_id=request.source_transaction_id,
        requested_line=request.requested_line,
        currency=request.currency,
        original_amount=calculation.original_amount,
        final_amount=calculation.final_amount,
        adjustment_amount=calculation.adjustment_amount,
    )


def cavas_directly_mutates_pos_transaction() -> bool:
    return False

import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitAdjustmentKind,
    BenefitApplicationRequest,
    BenefitApplicationStatus,
    build_benefit_application_instruction,
    calculate_benefit_application,
    cavas_directly_mutates_pos_transaction,
)


def _request(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        application_id="APP-1",
        policy_id="POL-1",
        policy_version="V3",
        contract_id="CTR-1",
        unit_id="UNIT-1",
        source_system="POS-CANONICAL",
        source_transaction_id="TX-1",
        requested_line="ALIMENTOS",
        currency="MXN",
        eligibility_decision="APLICA",
        eligible_base_amount=1000.0,
        adjustment_kind=BenefitAdjustmentKind.PERCENTAGE_DISCOUNT,
        adjustment_value=10.0,
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return BenefitApplicationRequest(**data)


def test_percentage_discount_calculation():
    calc = calculate_benefit_application(_request())
    assert calc.original_amount == 1000.0
    assert calc.adjustment_amount == 100.0
    assert calc.final_amount == 900.0


def test_fixed_discount_is_capped_at_eligible_base():
    calc = calculate_benefit_application(_request(
        adjustment_kind=BenefitAdjustmentKind.FIXED_DISCOUNT, adjustment_value=1500.0
    ))
    assert calc.adjustment_amount == 1000.0
    assert calc.final_amount == 0.0


def test_fixed_final_price_calculation():
    calc = calculate_benefit_application(_request(
        adjustment_kind=BenefitAdjustmentKind.FIXED_FINAL_PRICE, adjustment_value=750.0
    ))
    assert calc.adjustment_amount == 250.0
    assert calc.final_amount == 750.0


def test_non_eligible_transaction_cannot_receive_benefit():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calculate_benefit_application(_request(eligibility_decision="NO_APLICA"))


def test_percentage_cannot_exceed_100():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calculate_benefit_application(_request(adjustment_value=101.0))


def test_instruction_preserves_policy_and_source_transaction_evidence():
    instruction = build_benefit_application_instruction(_request())
    assert instruction.policy_id == "POL-1"
    assert instruction.policy_version == "V3"
    assert instruction.source_transaction_id == "TX-1"
    assert instruction.status == BenefitApplicationStatus.CALCULATED


def test_cavas_never_directly_mutates_pos_transaction():
    assert cavas_directly_mutates_pos_transaction() is False

constraints: NO alteracion directa de ventas, tickets, cargos o inventario comercial
La aplicacion requiere elegibilidad APLICA previa
Toda instruccion conserva policy_id + policy_version + contract_id + unit_id + source_system + source_transaction_id + currency + base + delta + final
El adaptador transaccional externo/canonico es responsable de ejecutar y confirmar la aplicacion real
